original_card.shared_mechanism: Currency-constraint duality (R010): the convex-duality bijection between a feasibility budget b on a lower-layer currency u and its dual shadow price lambda = dPhi*/db, made concrete through the single-constraint MaxCal / conditional-logit closure q_ij(lambda) = exp(-lambda u_ij)/Z. The same dual variable lambda is beta in D1 (u = energy) and the rate-distortion multiplier in D3 (u = distortion); only the declared currency u and budget b change. The underlying mathematical fact is one textbook lemma -- Lagrange/Legendre duality for a single-constraint convex program -- so the 'shared mechanism' is real but is convex duality, NOT a novel SBT structure.

original_card.minimum_viable_unification: A finite-Markov MaxCal laboratory (already executed and frozen, R010 MVR) showing that inverse temperature beta (D1) and the rate-distortion multiplier (D3) are the SAME shadow-price object lambda = dPhi*/db produced by ONE budget-constrained closure q ~ exp(-lambda u), with a measurable complementary-slackness signature (spearman(lambda,b) = -0.99923; n_tail_zero_lambda = 5 exactly on slack). This is an observable-preserving REORGANIZATION of Jaynes + Legendre duality: the dual map (budget b <-> price lambda) preserves the only observable both domains expose, the value function Phi*(b) and its slack signature. It does NOT derive temperature. The single SBT-specific increment (lower-layer spending becomes the higher-layer budget whose dual is lambda) is real vocabulary but rests on the UNPROVED persistence-as-budget postulate, and only ONE bridge (the D1/D3 complementary-slackness signature, quality 4) is non-analogical -- so by the brief's own bar (a unification's bridges cannot all be analogies) U018 scrapes a partial pass via the slack signature and the cycle-affinity ledger, while the D1 and D3 multiplier-identifications themselves remain analogical/operational.
original_card.baseline_comparison: RECOVERY, not improvement -- and the candidate honestly concedes this. The baseline is Jaynes MaxEnt (1957) + Boyd-Vandenberghe convex/Legendre duality: in equilibrium stat-mech beta is ALREADY the Lagrange multiplier of the mean-energy constraint with complementary slackness, and the identical dual-coordinate role is ALREADY recognized for chemical potential, market price (Arrow-Debreu), the rate-distortion multiplier (Berger; Cover-Thomas) and regularization strength -- all instances of a single-constraint convex dual variable. The unifying observation (one shadow price across thermodynamics and information theory) is textbook prior art a specialist already possesses. SBT produces no new value of beta, no new bound, no derivation from microdynamics; To_Spend itself concedes the standard result 'begins too late' (line 113) and that the cross-domain objects are 'the same kind of object in form' but 'not interchangeable in substance' (line 422). The DEFLATION critique reduces here to ONE textbook lemma (convex/Legendre duality), not three -- this is NOT a quotient or noncommutation mechanism. The only content beyond the baseline is the cross-LAYER reading (lower-layer currency becomes higher-layer constraint via packaging persistence); that single novel step is asserted, not proved, and the sole sharp signature is ansatz-forced. Verdict: does NOT beat the baseline; a 'maintenance-economics' costume over Jaynes + Legendre duality, with a named repair path.
original_card.why_scientists_care: It is the cleanest exemplar of SBT's duality-family selling point: a single dual map compressing temperature, the rate-distortion/information-bottleneck multiplier, and ML regularization strength into one shadow-price object lambda = dPhi*/db, legible to MaxEnt/MaxCal, rate-distortion/information-theory, convex-optimization, and ML-regularization audiences at once. The cross-layer 'why' (temperature as the price a stable macro-object pays to be maintained) is a genuinely suggestive reframing even though it is currently vocabulary. The MVU is coded and frozen (reproducible in days), and the repair path is concrete: proving the persistence-as-budget lemma plus a cross-substrate functor would upgrade the entire SBT duality family from naming to theorem and produce the first non-analogical bridge to rate-distortion. As a pedagogical/expository compression it is high-value; as new physics it is not.
original_card.stronger_unification: Prove the persistence-as-budget lemma as a genuine theorem (delta_{tau,f} <= eps => E[u|Y] <= b(eps) with explicit b(eps)), turning the cross-layer 'why' from vocabulary into machinery; THEN prove a functor / normal-form statement identifying beta-with-a-reservoir, the rate-distortion multiplier, and market price as one object with shared transformation laws across >=3 INDEPENDENT substrates -- each producing an actual lambda = dPhi*/db (not merely a completion U_f). This upgrades duration-family naming to a derived classification and would, for the first time, make a non-analogical observable-preserving bridge for D3.
bottlenecks: The persistence-as-budget step is ASSERTED, not a theorem (To_Spend line 224 'such as'); no allowed repair can supply delta <= eps => E[u|Y] <= b(eps) without forbidden new assumptions -- the maintenance-economics 'why' stays vocabulary.

The only sharp signature (monotone price, exact-zero slack) is analytically FORCED by the exp(-lambda u) ansatz (g' = -Var_q(u) < 0), so it is guaranteed, not risked, and confirms no SBT-specific claim.
The headline content (Jaynes MaxEnt + Boyd-Vandenberghe convex duality) is imported wholesale; impact capped at 1-2.

Cross-substrate 'one object' is informal: the second substrate (discrete BGK) yields a COMPLETION/lift U_f (an exp-family matching moments), NOT a dual variable lambda = dPhi*/db, so it does not instantiate the unification. The D3 bridge is identified only by shared form, with no functor.

This does NOT yet beat the deflation critique: it is Jaynes MaxEnt + Boyd-Vandenberghe convex/Legendre duality in a 'maintenance-economics' costume, honestly self-labeled. Concretely: (1) the headline content (beta = mean-energy multiplier; same multiplier in rate-distortion) is imported wholesale and is textbook prior art -- no new beta, no new bound, no derivation from microdynamics; To_Spend concedes the standard result 'begins too late' (line 113). (2) The single SBT-specific step, persistence-as-budget (delta_{tau,f} <= eps => E[u|Y] <= b(eps)), is ASSERTED (the hedged 'such as' at line 224), never proved -- the maintenance-economics 'why' is vocabulary, not machinery. (5) Of the bridges, only the complementary-slackness signature (quality 4) and the audit-DPI / cycle-affinity ledger guards (quality 4-5) are non-analogical, and those are DPI/Legendre facts, not novel SBT structure; the actual multiplier-identifications for D1 and D3 are operational/analogical. Elasticity inherited (~10 adjustable choices vs ~2 matched facts). The candidate is defensible ONLY as the explicitly-scoped recovery/reorganization with the named repair path (prove persistence-as-budget + build a cross-substrate functor); all SBT self-disclaimers honored, all quoted phrases <= 25 words and verified against To_Spend_a_Stone source (lines 113, 224, 235, 296, 298, 359-361, 422, 508).

compression.hidden_import_risk: HIGH. The whole headline (beta = mean-energy multiplier with complementary slackness; same multiplier in rate-distortion; q ~ exp(-lambda u)) is imported wholesale from Jaynes 1957 + Boyd-Vandenberghe convex/Legendre duality (cited lines 233, 243, 294-296). The single 'shared mechanism' (one shadow price lambda = dPhi*/db across two constrained programs) IS textbook convex duality, so the unification does not reduce assumption count -- it RE-DESCRIBES the same constrained-optimization objects under one label and ADDS one unproved postulate (persistence-as-budget, line 222 'such as'). Counting WITHOUT: D1 already gives beta as the energy-constraint multiplier (Jaynes); D3 already gives the rate-distortion multiplier (Berger/Cover-Thomas); D2 already gives Schnakenberg cycle affinities -- three separate but each-complete standard theories (~4 assumptions: MaxEnt, convex duality, RD theory, Schnakenberg). WITH U018 you must additionally import the SAME MaxEnt + duality PLUS the SBT cross-layer postulate that lower-layer maintenance spend E[u|Y]<=b is the budget whose dual is lambda (asserted, never proved) PLUS the choice of which audit proxy is the currency u -- so assumptions go UP (5 vs 4) and free parameters explode (~10: lens, cost matrix u_ij, budget b, exp(-lambda u) ansatz, Phi, tau/U_f, ladder depth, eps, which audit proxy, which second substrate) versus the ~6 a specialist would carry across the three native theories. The bridge maps smuggle the exact structure claimed to be unified: the exp(-lambda u) Gibbs form IS the answer, put in by hand. No compression; mild ANTI-compression bought by a vocabulary.

baseline.how_baselines_handle: EFT/RG (B_EFT) is the relevant baseline class for cross-scale 'one multiplier reappears', and the deeper baseline is the prior art the candidate itself names: Jaynes MaxEnt (1957) + Boyd-Vandenberghe convex/Legendre duality. A specialist ALREADY knows beta (D1), the chemical potential, the market price (Arrow-Debreu), the rate-distortion multiplier (D3, Berger; Cover-Thomas) and the regularization strength are all instances of ONE single-constraint Lagrange/Legendre dual variable -- this is textbook (the paper concedes it at line 113: standard duality 'begins too late', and line 422: the variables are 'the same kind of object in form' but 'not interchangeable in substance'). D2 (Schnakenberg cycle affinities) is separately a standard NESM result, used here only to manufacture the currency u via c(i->j)=max{0,log(P_ij/P_ji)} (line 302). None of the gravity/QG baselines (string/LQG/AdS-CFT/thermo-gravity/decoherence) touch these domains; thermodynamic-gravity is the only one philosophically adjacent (information/entropy as bookkeeping) but it uses PHYSICAL entropy and a horizon, which SBT explicitly disclaims (Sigma_T/EPR are informational proxies, no reservoir).
theory_advantage: A single explicitly measurable complementary-slackness signature (spearman(lambda,b)=-0.99923, n_tail_zero_lambda=5) demonstrated in one frozen finite-Markov MaxCal lab, packaging D1 and D3 multiplier-roles as one displayed object -- pedagogically clean and Lean-anchored on the audit DPI side (finiteKL_map_le).

The bridge maps smuggle the claimed structure: the exp(-lambda u) Gibbs form (line 296) and lambda=dPhi*/db (line 235) ARE the imported answer. HIGH hidden-import risk. (2) BASELINE: merely repackages textbook prior art (Jaynes 1957 + Boyd-Vandenberghe). A specialist already knows beta, chemical potential, market price, the rate-distortion multiplier and regularization strength are one single-constraint Lagrange/Legendre dual variable; the paper concedes standard duality 'begins too late' (line 113) and the variables are 'the same kind of object in form' but 'not interchangeable in substance' (line 422). No new beta, no new bound, no microderivation.
